  Location: tasmota/language/ca_AD.h:258
  Evidence: #define D_CONNECT_FAILED_WRONG_PASSWORD "[REDACTED]"
  Explanation: A credential-related name is assigned a literal value. Quoted assignments are checked in source/configuration, and plain values are also checked in .env files. FUSE cannot determine whether the value is valid or used.
  Potential impact: If the value is an active credential and the code or firmware is distributed, an unauthorized party may recover it and access the associated service or device.
  Remediation: Remove the literal, rotate the value if it was exposed, and provision secrets through a deployment-specific secret store or protected device provisioning flow.
  References: https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/798.html

[MEDIUM] FUSE004 - Non-loopback HTTP endpoint configured
  Confidence: high
  Location: tasmota/language/cs_CZ.h:17
  Evidence: http://www.gnu.org
  Explanation: A non-loopback URL explicitly uses HTTP. This indicates an unencrypted endpoint in source or configuration, but does not prove the endpoint is reachable or used.
  Potential impact: If the endpoint carries sensitive data over an untrusted network, traffic may be observed or modified in transit.
  Remediation: Use HTTPS with certificate verification for the service and confirm that the device rejects invalid certificates.
  References: https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/319.html
